decision: Practice is a daily mix with a cover, Play, Shuffle and a track list, the pattern popularized by music-streaming apps
why: People open a streaming app and press play without deciding what to hear; interview prep fails at exactly that decision. A mix removes the choice while showing why each track is there.
alternative: A to-do list of recommended drills.
value: One tap from opening Atlas to practicing the right thing.

decision: The now-playing bar is one custom element in @portfolio/chrome, mounted in the Atlas layout, with its state in sessionStorage
why: A layout-level player survives client navigation; storage makes it survive reloads and lets Pulse reuse the same element in SvelteKit.
alternative: Player state inside the mix page, lost on navigation.
value: Keeps playing while you browse Pipeline or Academy, in any stack.

decision: The mix is generated from rubric weakness and the next interview date, and each track states its reason with sources
why: A recommendation you can't question gets ignored; the reason is the product.
value: Members see and change the logic (shuffle by weakness, remove a track).

decision: The mix refreshes at 06:00, and a new track is inserted live when the world books a recruiter call (Orbital Freight)
why: A daily mix that ignores what happened an hour ago feels stale; pipeline events are the strongest signal of what to practice next.
value: The mix reacts to the pipeline within the same session.

decision: Shuffle by weakness reorders rows with FLIP (Web Animations on transform), and the playing row swaps its number for an equalizer
why: Rows that jump lose the reader; a glide shows where each track went.
alternative: Re-render the list in its new order instantly.
value: The reorder explains itself, and reduced motion gets an instant update.
